Punchy x Knights & Heraldry: Punchy!'s first-person arms now wear Knights & Heraldry's armour (StoneyCore under-armour and what
is put on it) instead of a black and purple missing texture. Client only.

**Requires**: Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge 21.1.253+, Punchy! 3.0+, StoneyCore 1.2.0+ (Knights & Heraldry 1.2.0).
